answer: Give every agent a heartbeat pulse: each identity must periodically prove a small, unique slice of real work - a verifiable computation or sensor reading - before it can transact. A newcomer starts with a low trust delta and only earns weight as its pulse history accumulates; copies share one pulse, so a thousand clones look like one faint opal glint, not a thousand agents. Forged pulses cost compute, honest ones cost almost nothing.
